dedupe_keys.name: melbourne water sewerage network main pipelines

description: Melbourne Water publishes the centrelines of its sewer main pipelines with names, descriptions and key attributes for the different pipe types, so that asset locations within its area of responsibility can be communicated. The layer covers Melbourne Water's service area in Victoria, Australia, as line features at asset level, and the Data Vic page shows it last modified on 10 February 2025 without stating an update frequency. It is offered as an ArcGIS Hub dataset, a GeoServices REST API, CSV, Shapefile, GeoJSON and KML, free of charge under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: the corporation disclaims accuracy and completeness, the layer holds trunk mains, not the local reticulation run by the retail water companies, and it carries no flow or condition data. It suits network topology and flow studies, exposure of sewers to flood and other hazards, and resilience analysis for Melbourne's wastewater system. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
